D/ [---] IVS PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, probably Trier mint, Reece period 17, possibly RIC vol. 8 page 152 no. 203 of Constantius II (323-361). Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: [---] IVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, object, ?resembling fir tree, between the figures. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: probably TRP. Diameter: 15.2mm, Weight: 1.39gms, die axis: 6
